ScopingInquiry.title: Scoping Inquiry
ScopingInquiry.description: A client-submitted scoping call request from the public Opportunities 2027 showcase.

referenceId.description: Unique human-readable reference code for the scoping request.

fullName.description: Full name of the executive sponsor submitting the request.

email.description: Work email address of the client contact (PII — admin read only).

role.description: Role or title of the requesting sponsor.

selectedServices.description: Bounded list (max 12) of shortlisted flagship or catalog service titles.

notes.description: Client context, deadlines, and engagement objectives.

status.description: Internal triage status managed by CBa Consult.

adminNotes.description: Internal follow-up notes maintained by CBa Consult.

emailDeliveryStatus.description: Outcome of optional server-side email or webhook notification.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the inquiry was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the inquiry was last updated.

AdminUser.title: Admin User
AdminUser.description: Authorized internal administrator allowed to read and manage scoping inquiries.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the admin record was created.

/scoping_inquiries/{inquiryId}.description: Persistent client scoping call inquiries. Public create-only with strict validation; read, list, update, and delete restricted exclusively to verified admins.

/admins/{uid}.description: Explicit administrator membership documents (read-own or admin-only; client writes blocked).
